description: This file defines the XValues class in the PdfSharp.Charting namespace, which represents a collection of values on the X-Axis of a chart. It provides methods to clone the collection, access items by index, and add new XSeries objects.

classes.name: XValues
classes.description: Represents the collection of values on the X-Axis in a chart, allowing addition, access, and copying of X-series data.

methods.name: XValues()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing a new empty collection of XValues.

methods.name: XValues(DocumentObject parent)
methods.description: Internal constructor initializing the collection with a parent object.

methods.name: Clone()
methods.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of the XValues collection.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Indexer to access an XSeries by its index, with type-safe casting and exception handling.

methods.name: AddXSeries()
methods.description: Creates and adds a new XSeries to the collection, returning the newly created object.
